who.text: God, Solomon, the wise and the simple.

where.text: Everyday life in Israel's towns and courts.

when.text: Material from the monarchy, collected into its final form later (possibly Persian period).

what.text: Practical wisdom for living in the fear of the LORD, contrasting the wise and the foolish across speech, work, relationships and desire. Genre: Wisdom sayings and instructions.

stakes.text: Shapes character and choices toward life rather than ruin.
